messages:
alex_sales: heads up — acme-payments wants a POC for BYO-KMS with CloudHSM in front of our inference nodes. 2-week pilot, 3 models, ~100 qps. they insist on customer-managed KEKs and daily rotation. how feasible?

mira_solutions: thanks alex. quick q: are they asking envelope encryption (wrap/unwrap) or an in-line proxy where we call their HSM for each sign/decrypt?

alex_sales: envelope w/ key-proxy. they want us to never hold plaintext KEK. also want signed rotation audit trail and attestation for regulators. pricing question: do we bill HSM egress/ops separately or include in Dedicated?

sam_security: we can integrate via key-proxy or use customer-wrapped keys. security constraints: no plaintext KEK persistence, ephemeral session keys only. we can emit signed rotation events (KMSEvent v1) and include an HSM attestation doc, but need customer's CloudHSM to support remote signing/verify API.

juna_engineer: technical note: runtime supports two integration modes: 1) external KMS proxy (HTTP/gRPC) and 2) pre-wrapped KEK injection at startup. For rolling rotation with minimal impact we do pre-warm of KV caches. if they want daily rotation (24h) we need to validate cache-warm paths — suggest a 48h pre-warm/validation window during POC.

juna_engineer: sample config we can test in POC:
```
kms:
  mode: external-proxy
  endpoint: https://kmproxy.customer.example.com
  wrapping: envelope
  rotation_check_hours: 24
  rotation_grace_hours: 48
```

mira_solutions: +1 to pre-warm. also note network egress: if their HSM is in another region we'll hit cross-region latency. include a perf test for 100 qps with 512-token avg.

liz_legal: from contract side we need SOW language: responsibilities (key escrow/backups owned by customer), accepted failure modes, and explicit prohibition on automatic plaintext fallback. require customer to provide attestation & any indemnity for key access during emergencies. I'll draft clauses.

alex_sales: customer asked if we can fallback to our managed keys if their HSM is down — they said they'd allow it only if wrapped by their KEK. is that realistic?

sam_security: we will not perform automatic plaintext fallback. acceptable pattern: customer supplies a pre-wrapped secondary KEK (wrapped by primary KEK) that we store encrypted; on failover we can use that wrapped key and call unwrap on their HSM during cutover. needs manual approval or documented runbook.

mira_solutions: practical customer option: provide per-region wrapped secondary keys and an explicit failover policy. we can expose a degraded read-only inference mode if they want stricter guarantees.

alex_sales: okay — need eng estimate and rough timeline to include in proposal + price for HSM pass-through.

juna_engineer: rough estimate for POC connector + infra + tests: dev 8d, infra 3d, qa 2d. integration test block 5d, pen-test coordination 2d. total ~20 engineering days. add 1 week for legal/SOW and 1 week for ops runbook & customer onboarding.

liz_legal: SOW will call out: 1) HSM pass-through billed as pass-through costs (customer pays provider) + 10% integration surcharge, 2) integration professional services (20 days at SE rate), 3) optional attestations (additional fee).

alex_sales: i'll update the proposal with the 20d line item and HSM pass-through note. i'll send draft SOW once liz has initial clause language. thanks all. :thumbsup:

ops_bot: reminder — create epic in JIRA: SALES-ACME-KMS-POC, attach this thread and assign to juna_engineer.

juna_engineer: created epic and linked initial spike. ping me for access to test CloudHSM.

alex_sales: will schedule kickoff with customer tomorrow 10am PT. agenda: perf targets, rotation ceremony, failover policy, SOW action items.

mira_solutions: i'll prepare checklist: network egress, certs, sample unwrap flow, and perf harness (locust). link to docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/kms-integration

sam_security: one more: customer requests on-demand rotation proof (hash of previous key + signed timestamp). we can provide signed rotation receipts in CSV/JSON. include in SOW.

alex_sales: logged. thanks team — i'll post SOW draft once liz shares language.
